description: Currency field. A money value with a chosen currency set (CurrencyTypes) and fixed decimal places (Decimalpoint). Captured live headless via copilot 2026-08-12 (field sweep #45); ids de-identified to synthetic Sample names.
notes: CurrencyTypes is a LIST of currency codes (captured: ["USD"]) — the set of currencies the field accepts, not a single string.
DefaultValue is the STRING "0" and Decimalpoint the STRING "2" — both wire strings, like Number (see field_number.json).

Validation offering: attach a FieldValidation::Criteria -> Condition (forge_add_field_validation), e.g. a max amount. The mechanism is captured live (CLAUDE.md F7); the exact operator set valid for Currency is a config-tabs sweep (#48) not yet run.

Computed offering: set the value from an event on a SOURCE field (forge_set_events -> Field::Event). Currency is not in trigger_for yet; family-inferred trigger is onSelect (Number family), unverified live.
